scores.tell: Candelabra arms are smooth thin tubes; tidy, slightly generic taper, but proportions and part count read right
Pool rings are fat pillowy tubes, soft blobby form and an overly large duck; rounder than real cards
Wagon has thin, spindly wheel spokes and a flat, box-like body with a missing tongue/front; the cover is a plain tube with a hole, and the wheels are too large
Phone booth has straight planar frames and crisp corners; the dome is slightly puffy and the windows are thin
Pier posts are slightly cylindrical and soft, rope thick but fine; planks flat; minor roundness on lifebuoy
Fins have clean silhouettes with tight bevels; slight swelling on the foot pockets
Boxing gloves are fat and inflated, with a bulbous toy-like form; the cuff straps are thick
Flip-flops have pillowy soles and bumps; the straps are sausage-thick, a little toy-like
Boot shaft is tall and tube-like and the heel is small; spur is thin; overall the silhouette is plausible but the shaft is a little stiff
Broom handle thin and straight, bristles bundled in clear tufts; the red binding is chunky but fine
